page.overview:
Who is Arklothac?

Arklothac is a multi-dimensional being that appears in the comics, and part of the Cosmic Elementals. He is a giant red monster that sports what appears to be an Italian chef mask on his head. He was summoned from beyond time and space by the witch Janice Bizzlethatcher and was later defeated by Finn with the Blade of the Defender.

He then returns with his fellow Cosmic Elementals to rain chaos on the world and presumably kill the main cast excluding Finn, who hides on the moon in waiting for a future hero. Later, Penelope, with the Blade of the Defender and the help of Finn, killed him and then had him erased from existence with the other Elementals.
